cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.10)
project(ex20_mass_spring_demo LANGUAGES CXX)

set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 20)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)

add_executable(demo_mass_spring
  demo_mass_spring.cpp
  mass_spring.cpp
  mss_function.cpp
)

target_include_directories(demo_mass_spring PRIVATE
  ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}
)
